text: Three Stars. Zested pieces do not fall through easily even with a sharp tap.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Zester and Grater
features: Sharp, etched stainless steel blades for fast, easy zesting and grating
Zest or grate citrus fruits, chocolate, and hard cheeses
Non-slip foot for more control while grating
Soft, comfortable, non-slip grip and top-rack dishwasher safe
description: When a recipe calls for zest, using the right tool is essential. The OXO Good Grips Zester features an etched stainless steel grating surface for perfectly zested citrus fruits or finely grated cheese. A soft, comfortable, non-slip handle provides a secure grip and cushions hands during repetitive grating motions.
